subject: E-Commerce
title: Seller Unions and Collective Action
description: A quick win: understand Seller Unions and Collective Action.

hook.text: Amazon sellers organized a one-day strike in 2023. Thousands paused listings to protest rising fees and policy changes.

buildup.text: Individual sellers have zero leverage against platforms. Collective action is the only way to push back on policies.

discovery.text: Seller forums and advocacy groups like ASGTG lobby for fair treatment and transparency in marketplace policies.

twist.text: Seller Unions and Collective Action has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Seller Unions and Collective Action matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: The goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: Why is seller collective action against marketplaces difficult?
options: Platforms control visibility and can retaliate against protesting sellers
